name: antd Segmented
summary: The antd Segmented control themed to aha-segmented, for an app that still renders antd's Segmented.
highlights: antd Segmented with the aha-segmented look
Already in the shared base theme
lead: New UI uses <aha-segmented>. An app that still renders antd's Segmented gets the same control from the shared base theme: segmentedTheme is that base, exported under its own name so a wrapper can say what it themes. Two implementations, one look.

spec.label: Item
spec.value: 32px tall, padding 0 16, 14px #4A4A4A label; #1A1A1A on hover with no hover fill

spec.label: Selected
spec.value: white thumb, radius 4, shadow 0 1px 2px ink 12%, #1A1A1A label

spec.label: Focus
spec.value: 2px Vivid Pink ring on keyboard focus; antd draws it 1px outside the item where aha-segmented insets it

spec.label: Differences
spec.value: aha-segmented's small and large sizes are not mapped; antd size="small" / "large" keep antd's heights

whenToUse.when: any new UI, React or Vue
an existing antd Segmented call site not yet moved to aha-segmented

opinion.note: Prefer <aha-segmented> for new UI. This theme only stops existing antd segmented controls from drifting (white track, 28px items).
opinion.dsv3: COVERED by the leaf: <aha-segmented> is the DS component. This contract only maps antd's Segmented onto the same look so apps that still render it do not drift; measured against the aha-segmented values.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: A composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page: React and antd load from a CDN and mount on open, using the same shared segmentedTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two vendor libraries at two Ant generations; they converge through the same theme (segmentedTheme). New UI uses <aha-segmented>, which needs no theme.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs on the rendered CDN-React preview: a real antd v6 Segmented inside a ConfigProvider bound to the shared base theme.
